description: Add a new custom Wazuh detection rule to the local_rules.xml file using the Wazuh dashboard rule editor. Navigate to Management > Rules, then click 'Custom rules' to open the local_rules.xml editor. Add a new rule with the following properties: rule ID 100010, severity level 9, triggered when rule 5710 fires (use the <if_sid> tag with value 5710), and a description of 'Invalid SSH user detected - potential unauthorized access attempt'. After adding the rule, click Save. The task is complete when the rule appears in the rules list and Wazuh confirms the file was saved successfully.

metadata.rule_description: Invalid SSH user detected - potential unauthorized access attempt
